place: a shop shelf of Stanley Quenchers

moments.what: the shelf pushes in, a Stanley label
the shelf dims, the yearly sales count up
a red marker rings one cup
a punch montage of Stanley shops

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Stanley sold $73M a year. Then one cup went viral.

place: a museum case of old Stanley bottles
old Stanley adverts on a desk

moments.what: old Stanley bottles in a museum case, black and white
a label: the old flask maker
old adverts thrown onto a desk one by one
a red stamp slams: barely sold

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Not a new cup. Stanley, the old flask maker, already sold this one, and it barely sold.

place: a woman shopping online in a park
a card paying at a laptop

moments.what: a woman at a laptop, cut out over the blurred park
A SHOPPING BLOG lands behind her
cut to a card paying on a laptop
a red SOLD OUT stamp slams

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So who saw it first? Three women who ran a shopping blog. They bought a batch themselves, sold it to their readers, and it was gone in days.

moments.what: a Crocs store front cut out over the blurred mall
FROM CROCS lands between the layers
an arrow: sold to women
cut to the colour wall, a marker rings a cup

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So what changed? Stanley hired a new boss from Crocs. He found the blog, and sold the cup to women, in new colours.

place: a bar chart of Stanley's yearly sales

moments.what: the bars start to draw
the second bar rises
the third bar doubles
the last bar towers, its figure counts up in gold

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Sales jumped to $94M, climbed to $194M, and hit $402M.

place: a shop shelf with a limit sign

moments.what: a LIMITED DROPS stamp slams
a red marker rings the limit sign
an arrow from the sign to the cups

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And Stanley added scarcity: limited colour drops. Shops put up signs limiting how many cups you could buy.

place: a gold poster over an old Stanley illustration

moments.what: the CNBC headline card drops in
cut to the gold poster over the old bottle
the gold figure catches its sheen

items.title: How a forty-ounce cup turned Stanley into a $750M a year business

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Four years later, Stanley was projected to sell more than $750M in a single year.

place: the shop shelf of Quenchers again

moments.what: back on the shelf of Quenchers
a label: it once barely sold

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Spot one in a cup holder today, and remember: it once barely sold.
